description: Relay a transaction the user's wallet already signed. Decodes it, runs the same checks as verify_tx (warnings only unless strict=true), and broadcasts. Optional private submission via Flashbots Protect on Ethereum mainnet. Cannot alter signed bytes. Returns hash + statusUrl. Supports EVM raw hex, Solana base64, Tron JSON, Bitcoin raw hex. Trustless: SwapChan never holds keys and cannot change a signed tx. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

chainId.description: Chain id (1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56, 43114, 59144, 534352, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron) or name (eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, solana, bitcoin, tron).

strict.description: Refuse to broadcast when verify_tx verdict is danger

name: broadcast_tx
title: Broadcast an already-signed transaction
